title: Plain G1 ECDLP via the pairing: (6,2) STNFS on a twisted C4 base field behind a run gate: expected work 2^117.305516092225

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, proof.md's algorithm (run gate, section 1, field-map.md, the GT core of proof.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns x from T=[x]P0 via z=e(T,Q0)=g^x, g=e(P0,Q0), with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under heuristics H1-H5, H-EA, H-X and H-FFT, at expected total classical work at most 1+(K/2^64) x 10 x (2^115.3401320190+2^66) < 2^117.305516092225 batched affine G1 additions (C=2,000 instructions; one core unit of 20,000 instructions = 10 units): an expectation over the challenge and the coins of the one attack on the one target, not a bound on every run. The attack first draws a 64-bit word u and stops as a failure (under one unit) unless u < K = 7203760764237811756, the least K with (K/2^64) x 0.998677 >= 0.39. Past the gate it succeeds with probability at least 0.998677, costs at most 2^125.236790330288 units (both logarithms metered at 2^121.9 core units) and at most 2^115.3401320190 core units in expectation (the two logarithms at their expected work 2^109.902, H5; every other row at its every-run bound). Nothing is amortized over other targets or runs. Analytic exploratory claim.
